b: A palm-sized 20-watt head from Orange, black-plate 6L6s from Tube Amp Doctor, an all-in-one acoustic DI from Journey, and three stereo pedals from Valeton.

Classic American 6L6 tone, built for today. The Tube Amp Doctor 6L6GC-STR BLACKPLATE and 6L6WGC-STR BLACKPLATE feature exclusive black-plate construction and gold grid wire. Inspired by RCA-style designs, they deliver defined lows, smooth highs, strong mids, and headroom—bringing back the 6L6 character guitarists have chased for decades.

This portable 20-watt, 1.5kg lunchbox head fits in the palm of your hand and is ideal for everything from desktop practice to small stages. With 3-band EQ for responsive tone shaping with Presence and Gain controls, footswitchable volume booster, and a Tubby Switch for extra richness, the Baby Terror packs a serious punch ready for every genre.

The DI-001K Journey Acoustic DI Preamp is a premium-quality, all-in-one acoustic DI preamp for musicians who want full control of their tone. Features 12-hour rechargeable battery, master volume, notch filter, 3-band EQ, Mute/Tuner pedal switch, 12 db pad, ground lift, and simultaneous 1/4 inch & XLR out.

Valeton’s VDS Series includes three compact stereo pedals: the VDS-1d Delay and Reverb, VDS-2d Dual Mod, and VDS-3d Dual Pitch Shifter. Explore Shimmer and Freeze, Series or Parallel modulation, and expressive pitch glides. Dual footswitches, intuitive controls, and rugged metal enclosures support creative sound shaping onstage and in the studio.
